## About
Crest Collision Center is a family owned and operated, independent collision center in Lawndale. We fix body damage, restore frames and uni-bodies, and match paint so your car comes back looking like it did before the accident.
Repairs are done to the standards set by your vehicle manufacturer. We mix paint on site with BASF Color Max so we can adjust the color until it's right, and we use digital imaging systems for frame work.
Drivers come to us from around the South Bay, Hawthorne, Lawndale, Gardena and Torrance. We're rated 4.8 from 137 Google reviews, and when you call, you'll likely talk with Mark or Sheila in the front office.

## Services
- Auto body repair and painting: Collision and body repair done to your vehicle manufacturer's standards, from bumpers to side swipes.
- Frame and uni-body restoration: We use three dimensional measuring and digital imaging systems for frame restoration and all uni-body repairs.
- Color match and refinish: BASF Color Max color matching and a waterborne, low-VOC base coat, with paint mixed on site so we can get the color just right.
- Insurance claims help: We help move your insurance claim along. One reviewer said the office was quick to act on insurance requests and send photos.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Stop by our shop on Manhattan Beach Blvd in Lawndale and we'll look at your car and give you an estimate.

Q: Can you help with my insurance claim?
A: Yes. We work as an insurance claims expediter, and one reviewer said we were quick to handle insurance requests and send photos.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
